name: sprint-portfolio-kit
description: A design-sprint companion that captures decisions, rejected directions, pivots and metric moves live into the student's project folder, then compiles the whole folder into a portfolio-ready web case study.

plugins.name: sprint-portfolio
plugins.description: Live-capture design decisions, metric moves and research findings into a project folder during a sprint, then build a portfolio-ready RTL case study from it. Includes /start-sprint, /log-decision and /build-portfolio.
